metadata.scenario: A new customer is frustrated because their issue has not been resolved after several attempts. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Agnes Rodriguez. I’m calling because I’m really frustrated with the service I’ve been receiving lately. I'm sorry to hear that, Agnes. Can you tell me more about what's been going on? Well, I've been trying to get a consistent companion for my visits, especially since I have mild dementia. But it seems no one is showing up as scheduled! I completely understand your frustration. How long has this been happening? It’s been about three weeks now. I’ve called multiple times, and each time I’m told someone will be assigned, but… nothing. I apologize for the inconvenience, Agnes. Let me pull up your account and see what’s been happening. Please do, because I really depend on these visits for social interaction. It’s hard to manage my feelings of isolation without a consistent caregiver. I absolutely understand. Your well-being is our priority. Just a moment while I check your recent service history. Thank you. It’s just disappointing, especially since I've been a client for two years now. I see here that there have been some staffing issues recently. I apologize for the lack of communication on our part. Would you like me to escalate this issue to ensure you get a consistent companion? Yes, please! I can’t keep going like this. Of course, I’ll make sure to escalate this to our Client Services Manager, Angela. She’ll reach out to you directly. What’s the best number to reach you? You can reach me at my usual number, +13165551234. Got it. I will also note that you enjoy gardening activities. Would you be interested in adding a caregiver who has experience in that area? That sounds wonderful! It would really make the visits more enjoyable for me. I’ll make sure to include that in the request. Is there anything else you’d like me to address while I have you on the line? No, I think that covers it. I just really hope this gets resolved soon. I assure you, Agnes, we’ll do everything we can to resolve this quickly. Thank you for your patience. Thank you for listening to my concerns, Margaret. It’s my pleasure, Agnes. I’ll follow up with you once I have more information. I appreciate it. Have a good day! You too! Take care. Bye. Goodbye.
